name: Random Grid Transition
description: Pinned scroll sequence where full-screen images are revealed through a grid of cells fading in at random, with titles clipped in per slide and a segmented progress bar.
contents: Optional intro screen with title and scroll hint
Pinned stage with one full-screen image per slide, kicker pill, counter, title and description
behavior: Smooth scrolling through Lenis drives the whole page
Scroll scrubs a GSAP timeline that fades SVG mask cells in at random order to reveal each image
Slide text wipes in and out with a clip-path
Grid column count changes by mobile, tablet and desktop breakpoints and rebuilds on resize
editableByProps: Grid density per breakpoint, reveal stagger and scrub smoothness
Intro, outro and progress bar visibility

needsCodeEdit.where: filter brightness style on the image element

needsCodeEdit.change: Change reveal or text animation timing

fixed: Lenis takes over page scrolling and is destroyed on unmount
Stage height is slides count times 100vh to provide the pinned scroll range
Playfair Display and Space Mono fonts are not loaded by the component, the host must provide them or override the font props
